question: What additional essential form characterizes the supreme goddess alongside being the nature of all beings?
premises: The supreme goddess is of the nature of all beings.
The goddess is also characterized by another essential form.
This additional form is that of the primordial self-liṅga.
inference: Therefore, the supreme goddess embodies both the nature of all beings and the form of the primordial self-liṅga.
uncertainties: The internal analysis of ādātmaliṅga as ādi-ātma-liṅga follows the legacy hint but the exact compound resolution is interpretive.
plain_english: She is of the nature of all beings and has the form of the primordial self-liṅga.
